title: Among molecules labeled as carcinogenic (label = '+'), calculate the percen
question: Among molecules labeled as carcinogenic (label = '+'), calculate the percentage that contain at least one atom of either carbon or fluorine, and also have at least one single bond ('-').

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a."XCL_003" IN ('c', 'f') AND b."XCL_006" = '-' THEN m."XCL_010" END) AS REAL) * 100 /
  COUNT(DISTINCT m."XCL_010") AS percentage
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN bond b ON b."XCL_005" = m."XCL_010"
WHERE m."XCL_011" = '+'

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a."XCL_003" IN ('c', 'f') AND b."XCL_006" = '-' THEN m."XCL_010" END) AS REAL) * 100 /
  COUNT(DISTINCT m."XCL_010") AS percentage
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN bond b ON b."XCL_005" = m."XCL_010"
WHERE m."XCL_011" = '+'

  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a."XCL_003" IN ('c','f') AND b."XCL_006" = '-' THEN m."XCL_010" END) AS REAL) * 100 /
  COUNT(DISTINCT m."XCL_010") AS percentage
